details.report: Committed Navigator acquisition proof completion. Added production Recorder activation checks for both label-policy mappings; exercised createGhJsonTransportV1 through acquisition with null parent and child bodies; completed evidence admission coverage for generated/duplicate IDs, non-string/noncanonical paths, FIFO/device/oversize files, capability containment, immutable post-admission bytes, and failed-read accounting; and proved empty, overlapping, adjacent, sparse, failed-decode, and large bounded paging agreement between live Navigator reads and sealed reconstruction. Gates passed: typecheck, 414 tests (409 pass, 5 skip), build:recorder, git diff --check, and npm pack --dry-run.
